why: A 2025 paper by Yaqubi and Mirzavaziri, 'New results on Wolstenholme's theorem and its applications,' and a Nov 2024 paper 'Extending Wolstenholme's Theorem: A New Perspective' by the same authors appear to prove partial/new cases relevant to the converse (extending which composite integers satisfy or fail the congruence), but search snippets did not let me confirm whether these narrow the converse's open cases or are about a related generalization; the general converse conjecture is still described as open as of 2025.
queries: converse Wolstenholme theorem arxiv 2024 2025 case settled
